# Beginner-Friendly London Yoga Options for Lower Back Stiffness

For your dates and budget, the best fit is usually a **gentle / restorative / Hatha** class in central or well-connected London, with **small group size** and **mat provided**. Since schedules and prices can vary by studio, compare options using the same criteria so you can book quickly.

## Compare London Class Options

| Option | Best for | Typical price target | What to verify |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Gentle Hatha class | True beginner-friendly pacing | £12–£18 | Mat included, max class size, evening start after 18:30 |
| Restorative / Yin class | Lower back stiffness, slow holds | £14–£18 | Teacher experience with back issues, props provided |
| Beginner flow class | Slightly more movement, still accessible | £10–£17 | Clear beginner label, small class size, mat availability |
| Private intro session | Most tailored for back stiffness | £15–£18 per person if shared; often higher solo | Whether a 1:1 or intro offer exists |

### What to prioritize
- **Class style:** choose **Gentle Hatha** or **Restorative/Yin** first.
- **Back support:** ask if the teacher can offer **modifications for lower back stiffness**.
- **Small class size:** aim for **10–12 people max** if possible.
- **Included equipment:** confirm **mat included** and whether blocks/straps are available.
- **Timing:** filter for **starts after 18:30** in **Europe/London**.

### Fast shortlist method
- Start with studios near Tube or rail lines to reduce travel stress.
- Filter for “beginner,” “gentle,” “restorative,” or “slow flow.”
- Exclude hot yoga, power vinyasa, and advanced flow unless clearly modified.
- If two classes look similar, pick the one that explicitly mentions **small classes** or **individual attention**.

## Concise Booking Inquiry Draft

Subject: Beginner evening yoga class inquiry for 15–21 June

Hello,

I’m looking to book a **beginner-friendly evening yoga class** in London for **1 adult** between **15 and 21 June 2026**, with a start time **after 18:30**.

I have **lower back stiffness**, so I’d appreciate a **gentle class** with options for modifications. My budget is **under £18 per class**. Could you please confirm:
- whether the class is suitable for beginners
- the **maximum class size**
- whether a **mat is included**
- if the teacher can offer guidance for lower back stiffness
- the available evening dates and times in that week

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
